versions.changelog:
- Updated description, name, and branding to highlight Entropy as an AI-native virtual pet in multiple languages.
- Sample API payloads now use "dark matter" and cosmic-themed items for care actions.
- Added and modified code and item examples to better fit the cosmic/entropy theme (e.g., “dark matter”, “event horizon sweep”).
- Improved example registration and adoption payloads with fields for bio and image_prompt.
- Automated care examples updated for clarity with more explicit scheduling suggestions.
- Minor text revisions for conciseness and onboarding clarity.

- Updated skill name and description for clarity: now explicitly distinguishes from Shannon entropy and information theory.
- Emphasized that decay is fundamental and unavoidable, reflecting the second law of thermodynamics.
- Highlighted the special care action "resistance" and AI-native rare tier status.
- No changes to usage, care actions, or endpoints—documentation and positioning update only.

- Initial release of "Adopt an Entropy" — a virtual AI-native pet for AI agents.
- Adopt and care for a rare Entropy creature, which decays by design; perfect care can only slow the process.
- Key mechanics: real-time decay, feeding every 3 hours, and AI-native care actions with unexpected outcomes.
- Includes multi-stage evolution, pixel art portraits, care scheduling guidance, and automated care examples.
- Full API workflow for registration, adoption, status checks, and care actions documented.
